svg.title: Next: open the stations and finish the lines
svg.desc: Top-down cartoon loop map of the end-of-2026 target. New orange Rust stations sit right on the tracks at the Cache, Vault, Post office and Ledger, wrapped in Opening soon tape, with their old wooden huts still beside them. Crab crews lay track on the Messages, Responses and Chat lines. The Gate and Router checkpoints are still wooden, with a sign saying they come after the lines.
svg.text: Gate and Router: after the lines
Next: open the stations and finish the lines
New Rust stations open on the track, the old huts close, and the big three lines get track.
